# End-of-Week Summary

**Done**
- **Android beta released.** The beta build has gone out.
- **Onboarding emails rewritten.** The new copy is complete.

**In progress**
- **Search relevance tuning.** Work is ongoing.

**Blocked**
- **Legal review of the new terms.** We've been waiting since last Monday with no response yet. Any dependent work is on hold until it clears.
- **Ask:** If anyone has a contact in Legal or can help escalate, please say so. A follow-up from our side this week would also help.

I didn't have details on next steps, metrics, or owners, so I left those out. If you send them, I can add a "Next week" section, beta rollout numbers, or names. I can also make it shorter for Slack.
